description: Answer "what is the cheapest way to track <index>?". Returns every fund tracking one index ordered cheapest fee first, deduplicated to one row per FUND rather than per venue listing (a five-venue UCITS fund is one choice, not five) with its listingCount and venues. Defaults to UCITS-buyable domiciles. Omit indexKey to list the available index families. Fees are percentage points and the response states how many funds publish no fee at all, so a "cheapest" claim is never made over silently omitted funds. Read-only. Successful results include an optional platformLink for continuing this research or reviewing the exact saved draft in Bullrun. When useful, present its descriptive link and respect its description of any settings not carried over.

distributionPolicy.description: Optionally keep only accumulating or only distributing share classes.

indexKey.description: Normalized index key, e.g. SP500, MSCI_WORLD, NASDAQ100, MSCI_EM, EURO_STOXX_50, TOPIX, FTSE100. Omit to list every index family that has at least one fund.

limit.description: Maximum funds (or index families) to return, 1-100.

scope.description: ucits (default) restricts to domiciles a European retail investor can actually buy. all adds US-domiciled trackers, which look cheaper but are not purchasable by EU retail.

name: get_etf_index_group
title: Compare funds tracking one index
